blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Police arrested a 19-year-old suspect on Sunday morning, Oct. 25, in connection with the death of his live-in partner, a 17-year-old student who was declared dead on arrival at a hospital in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat. The Isulan Municipal Police Station identified the suspect as Norberto Marcella Jr., a packer at MGM Shopping Plaza and a resident of Barangay Sewod, Senator Ninoy Aquino. He was arrested at 8:30 a.m. following a hot pursuit operation.
